title: Cloud Run YAML configuration
description: Configuration file of the terraform-google-cloud-run-yaml module.

project_id.description: Default project for every service and job in this file. Takes precedence over the module's project_id variable; a service- or job-level project_id takes precedence over this.

services.description: Cloud Run services keyed by logical key (the default service name).

jobs.description: Cloud Run jobs keyed by logical key (the default job name).

template_placeholder.description: A ${...} placeholder, replaced when the module renders the file with templatefile().

labels.description: Key/value labels. Numbers and booleans are converted to strings.

deletion_policy.description: Provider-level deletion policy. PREVENT makes terraform destroy fail; ABANDON removes the resource from state without deleting it.

member.description: IAM member: user:, group:, serviceAccount:, domain:, principal://, principalSet://, allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.

iam_binding.description: Grants one IAM role to one or more members (non-authoritative, one *_iam_member per member).

members.description: Members to grant the role to.

defaults.description: Values applied to every service and job unless it sets its own. See docs/configuration.md for the merge rules.

region.description: Default region of every service and job. Takes precedence over the module's region variable.

labels.description: Labels added to every service and job.

services.description: Default service settings, merged underneath every service (mappings merge up to three levels deep; lists and other values are replaced).

jobs.description: Default job settings, merged underneath every job.

service_container.description: Default container settings, merged underneath every container of every service (up to three levels deep).

job_container.description: Default container settings, merged underneath every container of every job.

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this service (default true). It is still validated.

name.description: Service name (default: the key). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 49 characters.

project_id.description: Project of this service. Takes precedence over the top-level project_id.

region.description: Region of this service. Takes precedence over defaults.region.

labels.description: Labels, merged over defaults.labels and defaults.services.labels.

annotations.description: Service annotations (not revision annotations; those go in template.annotations).

client.description: Name of the client that last deployed the service, e.g. terraform.

ingress.description: Which traffic may reach the service.

launch_stage.description: Launch stage; set BETA or ALPHA to use preview features.

deletion_protection.description: Whether terraform destroy may delete the service. The provider default is true: set false for services that may be destroyed.

custom_audiences.description: Extra audiences accepted in ID tokens for this service.

default_uri_disabled.description: Disable the run.app URL (only reachable through a load balancer or custom domain).

invoker_iam_disabled.description: Skip the IAM invoker check: anyone who can reach the service may call it (public without allUsers).

iap_enabled.description: Put Identity-Aware Proxy in front of the service.

traffic.description: Traffic split between revisions. Default: 100% to the latest revision.

invokers.description: Members allowed to call the service (roles/run.invoker). allUsers makes it public.

iam.description: Additional IAM grants on the service.

schedules.description: Cloud Scheduler jobs that call the service on a schedule, keyed by name.

service_template.description: The revision template: containers, volumes, scaling and networking of new revisions.

revision.description: Revision name (must start with the service name followed by a hyphen). Default: generated.

encryption_key.description: Cloud KMS key for the image (CMEK).

session_affinity.description: Route a client's requests to the same instance.

health_check_disabled.description: Disable the default TCP startup check.

containers.description: Containers: the ingress container and optional sidecars.

vpc_access.description: VPC egress: a Serverless VPC Access connector or Direct VPC network interfaces.

egress.description: Which traffic goes through the VPC.

network_interfaces.description: Direct VPC egress interfaces (instead of a connector).

network.description: VPC network name or self link.

name.description: Container name. Required when the template has several containers (for depends_on and overrides).

depends_on.description: Names of containers that must start (and pass their startup probe) before this one.

env.description: Plain environment variables. Numbers and booleans become strings.

secret_env.description: Environment variables from Secret Manager, NAME: { secret, version }.

base_image_uri.description: Base image for automatic base image updates.

service_resources.description: Compute resources of a service container.

cpu_idle.description: Throttle CPU outside requests (request-based billing; default true). false: instance-based billing.

resource_limits.description: Resource limits, e.g. { cpu: "2", memory: 1Gi, nvidia.com/gpu: "1" }.

port.description: The port the ingress container listens on.

name.description: Protocol: http1 (default) or h2c (HTTP/2 end-to-end, gRPC).

probe.description: A startup or liveness probe. Set one of http_get, tcp_socket and grpc.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

failure_threshold.description: Failures before the container is restarted (or the start fails).

readiness_probe.description: A readiness probe. Set one of http_get and grpc.

failure_threshold.description: Failures before the instance stops receiving traffic.

success_threshold.description: Successes before it receives traffic again.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

service.description: Service name passed to the gRPC health check.

secret.description: Secret ID in the service's project, or projects/P/secrets/S.

name.description: Name of a volume of the template.

mount_path.description: Directory to mount at, e.g. /secrets. Cloud SQL volumes conventionally mount at /cloudsql.

sub_path.description: Path within the volume to mount instead of its root.

volume.description: A volume. Set exactly one of secret, cloud_sql_instance, empty_dir, gcs and nfs.

default_mode.description: Mode of all files: an octal string such as "0444" (quoted: YAML reads unquoted 0444 as the decimal 444), or a decimal number such as 292.

items.description: Versions to mount and their file names (default: latest as a file named after the secret).

secret_item.description: A secret version mounted as a file.

path.description: File name relative to the mount path.

mode.description: Mode of this file: an octal string such as "0400", or a decimal number such as 256.

gcs_volume.description: A Cloud Storage bucket mounted with Cloud Storage FUSE (needs EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_GEN2 for services).

type.description: LATEST (newest ready revision) or REVISION (the named revision); the long provider forms are accepted too.

tag.description: Tag: the target also gets its own URL https://TAG---SERVICE-HASH.run.app.

service_schedule.description: Calls the service on a schedule with an OIDC token.

time_zone.description: Time zone of the schedule, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default UTC).

description.description: Description of the Cloud Scheduler job.

region.description: Cloud Scheduler region (default: the service's region).

service_account_email.description: Identity of the call. Needs roles/run.invoker: add it to invokers.

body.description: Request body (plain text; the module encodes it).

retry_config.description: Cloud Scheduler retries of a failed attempt.

max_doublings.description: How often the wait doubles before growing linearly.

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this job (default true). It is still validated.

name.description: Job name (default: the key). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 63 characters.

labels.description: Labels, merged over defaults.labels and defaults.jobs.labels.

client.description: Name of the client that last deployed the job.

launch_stage.description: Launch stage; set BETA or ALPHA to use preview features.

deletion_protection.description: Whether terraform destroy may delete the job. The provider default is true.

start_execution_token.description: Change this value to start an execution when the job is created or updated (apply waits until it has started).

run_execution_token.description: Change this value to run an execution when the job is created or updated (apply waits until it has completed).

invokers.description: Members allowed to execute the job (roles/run.invoker). Scheduler service accounts belong here.

iam.description: Additional IAM grants on the job.

schedules.description: Cloud Scheduler jobs that execute the job on a schedule, keyed by name.

job_template.description: What an execution runs: the provider's execution template and task template in one mapping.

parallelism.description: Tasks running at the same time (default: as many as possible).

task_count.description: Tasks per execution (default 1). Each task gets CLOUD_RUN_TASK_INDEX.

timeout.description: Time limit per task attempt, e.g. 3600s.

encryption_key.description: Cloud KMS key for the image (CMEK).

job_container.description: A container of a job task.

name.description: Container name. Required when the template has several containers (for depends_on and overrides).

depends_on.description: Names of containers that must start (and pass their startup probe) before this one.

env.description: Plain environment variables. Numbers and booleans become strings.

secret_env.description: Environment variables from Secret Manager, NAME: { secret, version }.

job_resources.description: Compute resources of a job container.

job_schedule.description: Executes the job on a schedule (Cloud Run Admin API, OAuth token).

time_zone.description: Time zone of the schedule, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default UTC).

description.description: Description of the Cloud Scheduler job.

region.description: Cloud Scheduler region (default: the job's region).

service_account_email.description: Identity of the call. Needs roles/run.invoker on the job (add it to invokers), or roles/run.jobsExecutorWithOverrides with overrides.

timeout.description: Task timeout for this run, e.g. 600s.
